pages.text:
Ecosystem - Campaign Extensions

Background:
Xfinity products and services work better together. We create tech that fuels your life. With our new creative platform Imagine That , we need to
communicate our broader product ecosystem in a way that makes experiences feel like magic. This should come through across all aspects of the campaign
extensions — through visual themes and elements that tie in with compelling messaging and our core product offerings that will drive consumers to take
action.

Business Objective:
Evolve Xfinity to be about more than just WiFi, our WiFi is amazing but so are our products – we have an opportunity to reset what consumers think about
our brand and what we have to offer as one stop shop for your life. Individually, our products are amazing, but the saying “t he whole is greater than the
sum of its parts” happens to be true in this case as well. Together, they’re just better. Our products work better together as an integrated experience
fueled by Xfinity and powered by WiFi AND the Xfinity app is the connective tissue that binds them; everything your WiFi touches is controlled at your
fingertips.

Target Audience:
Total audience – prospect and customer (GM)

Communication Objective:
Make us a brand that people want to be a part of, known for our premium WiFi and broader ecosystem of products that seamlessly connect to fuel your
life.

Key Message:
Xfinity WiFi fuels my life, and their products works seamlessly together to give me the most enhanced technology experience.

Reasons To Believe:
Refer to next page

Creative Considerations:
• A few new visual toolkit items were delivered through the Xfinity brand team
• Leverage new Imagine That messaging guidelines coming soon (see evolved brand voice here )
• Any references/tie-ins to other creative concepts being developed by GSP (TV/Radio/OLA) should be considered
• Should look, feel and sound consistent to other Imagine That extensions like OOH, DM, Social

Reasons to Believe – by tactic length

• Long form Tactics (Print, :60 DJ,)
• Mid length Tactics (:30 DJ Read, Animated Display)
• Short Form Tactics (:15, :10 DJ Read, Static Banner & OOH)
*Italicized lines are headlines provided by GSP as proof of execution. Can
be used as is, but also encourage these to be used for inspiration for add’l
lines.

Long Form Tactics
(Print, :60 DJ,)
1. Xfinity products are better together.
• What if your WiFi, mobile, streaming, and security all
joined forces for good?
• What if your WiFi, mobile, streaming, and security all
joined forces to create one unstoppable connection?
2. Not all WiFi is created equal. I have the Smartest WiFi on earth.
• With Xfinity WiFi your home isn’t just smart, it’s
brilliant.
3. With Xfinity, I have a seamless and convenient product
experience that is unmatched by any other competitor. Using the
entire Xfinity ecosystem is better together fueled by WiFi.
• With Xfinity WiFi, everything in your home works better
together.
• Xfinity WiFi brings your whole home together.
4. The Future of mobile is WiFi first. I have WiFi where it counts, and
5G everywhere else.
• What if the Xfinity WiFi you trust at home could follow
you everywhere you take your phone?
5. True Fans stream with Xfinity. As a true sports fan, I have Xfinity,
the ultimate sports destination.
• What if you were the best at watching sports?
• What if your sofa was the best seat in the house?
6. With the Xfinity gateway, I have a forcefield for my life.
• What if you could put a forcefield around your home in
the click of a button?

• With Xfinity WiFi, everything in your home works

• Xfinity WiFi brings your whole home together.

OOH)

• What if your WiFi, mobile,
streaming, and security all joined

• What if your WiFi, mobile,

• With Xfinity WiFi, everything in

• Xfinity WiFi brings your whole

Ecosystem - Campaign Extensions

Channels:
DJ Reads, Print, Standard Display and Custom, OOH

Deliverables:
Print (GM) *Should version for both Standard & Custom CTA
• Standard print with no offer
• Newspaper sizes (Full & half page)
• Sales collateral with no offer
• Flyer (Double Sided 8.5x11”)*
• Door Hanger (Double Sided 4x12”)*
• Digital flyer
DJ Reads (GM)
• :60, 30, :15, :10
• CTAs should drive to Xfinity.com
Display (GM)
• Standard desktop sizes (animated and static)
• Standard mobile sizes (animated and static)
• Custom display units as needed
• CTAs should drive to Xfinity.com/ es.Xfinity.com
OOH
• Print & digital

Media Placement & Budget:
HQ media

Production Budget:
In scope ( Imagine That extensions budget)

Timing:
In-market: 9/22
Final files due/Traffic: Week of 8/25 (custom & digital standard)
